author: opt-W2

contract.sync_assumed: caller separates consecutive calls that reuse the temp storage by a block barrier (the harness does)
contract.sync_performed: 1 __syncthreads for bf16 (after the per-warp phase), 3 for fp32 on the fast path (plus 2 per slow tie round), redux.sync inside the warps
contract.k_range: [1, N/2] with Warps x k at most 2048, measured 4 to 64
contract.n_range: N = 256 x IPT, measured 1024 to 16384 (temp storage 8 k words plus 4 counters, 752 bytes at k 16)
contract.type_constraints: bf16 exact and fp32 through the N4 truncated-key word with a block-scope tie pass, int32 indices from the position
contract.tie_break_support: inherent (packed word), same code for both requirements, measured with not_guaranteed only in this batch since B1 supports only that
contract.sorted_output_support: inherent, the merge output is sorted

low_level: B2_packed (opt-B2's adapter at commit 8212d9e0d2, copied unchanged into harness/adapters) runs at 21 registers for bf16 at N 1024 to 4096 and 64 to 80 at N 16384 against 28 to 48 and 79 to 127 for B5, with k + 15 BAR.SYNC in the latency kernel (one per round) against B5's 7 (one per call). Both are spill free for bf16, B5 fp32 at N 16384 spills 136 to 608 bytes at 255 registers where B2 stays at 215 to 255 without spills.

B5's one barrier against B2's k barriers does not translate into throughput: B5 phase 2 runs on warp 0 while 7 warps wait at the exit, so per block the SM has 8 warps active for phase 1 and 1 warp for phase 2, whereas B2 keeps all 8 warps issuing one atomic per round. Occupancy is 8 blocks per SM for both at N 1024 to 4096 bf16.
Canary 32.001 at start and end, R squared 1.0000 up to N 4096 and 0.998 to 1.0 at N 16384, node umbriel-b200-047.
algorithmic: Kill criterion of the B5 card (1.15x faster than B2 at block N 1024 k 16 bf16): latency 1194 against 1380 cycles, 1.16x, throughput 361 against 494 Gelem/s, 0.73x. B5 passes the latency threshold by one percent at that one cell and fails it in throughput.

Everywhere else B2 wins or ties: N 1024 k 4 tie (378 against 380), k 8 1.10x and k 32 1.14x for B5 in latency with 0.64 to 0.78x in throughput, N 4096 B2 1.1 to 1.4x faster in latency and 1.3 to 1.7x in throughput, N 16384 B2 faster except k 4 (B5 1.32x latency, 1.16x throughput, where B2's per-round barrier chain of 4 rounds is short and B5's 64-item per-lane prologue is amortized). fp32 (both through N4 words): B5 1.06 to 1.08x at N 1024 k 16 and 32 in latency, B2 wins every other cell and all throughput cells by 1.1 to 1.5x.

The cost model that held: B5 is about 70 k + 250 at N 1024 (two warp phases of 26 to 30 per round plus the merge list growth), B2 measured about 85 k + 40 (1380 at k 16, 2740 at k 32, 5397 at k 64), so the round gap is 15 cycles per k instead of the 22 the card assumed and B2's prologue is 200 cycles cheaper than B5's two prologues plus exchange.
prefer_smaller_index is free for both (identical cycles in all 30 cell pairs of each adapter).
negative: The hierarchical composition does not pay against the packed atomic rounds of B2 at block scope: the exchange and the second prologue cost what the barrier per round saves, and B5 loses occupancy at N 16384 (2 against 3 blocks per SM for bf16) because warp 0's merge list adds registers. Verdict: close B5 for the focus set, B2 owns block extraction at small k.
k 64 is 1.3x slower than B2 and 3.5x slower than B1 at N 1024, as in the B1 batch.
surprises: B2_packed at 21 registers is cheaper than any warp-scope W2 configuration at the same items per thread, the shared-memory atomic round at 256 threads has no per-lane list sorting beyond IPT 4 and no merge, which the July hier_extract comparison did not have (its warp round was 82 cycles).
open_questions: Whether B5 keeps a niche for a latency-only consumer that needs one barrier per call at N 1024 k 8 to 32 (1.10 to 1.16x in latency), which depends on the consumer's barrier budget, not on this harness.

The fp32 next-word check at block scope (each warp emits k + 1 words, warp 0 checks the (k+1)-th candidate) would remove two barriers and the per-item count from B5's fp32 path, about 250 cycles at N 1024 k 16, not enough to change the verdict on the model.

correctness_notes: oracle battery passed on all 60 cells (both requirements, both key types). The control B2_packed is opt-B2's adapter from branch exp/topk-swarm/B2 commit 8212d9e0d2, copied unchanged into this worktree's harness/adapters (it includes only the shared harness header).
